name: Feature Request

title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working?

## Alternative Solutions
Are there any alternative approaches you've considered?

## Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Additional Context
- Would this be a new tool, admin feature, or API enhancement?
- Are there existing plugins/tools that do something similar?
- Would this require new dependencies?

## Mockups/Examples
(Optional) Add any mockups, diagrams, or examples to illustrate the feature.
